title: 第19章 魔兽山脉第20章 杀退蛇群
content_zh:
魔兽山脉树木参天，妖兽遍地，哪怕是边缘地带，也生活着不少的妖兽。
只是外围的妖兽境界比较低下，看到浩浩荡荡的人类修士队伍，都远远的躲开，不敢轻易招惹。
队伍的目标也明确，所以没有在那些小妖兽的身上浪费时间，二十多人呈前后拱卫状，将宝药堂的人保护在其中，有序的朝着毒林进发。
前段一路无事，可随着一行人的深入，周围的森林开始变得危机四伏了起来，总感觉附近的一些灌木里有东西在观测他们，如若有一丝一毫的放松，就会对他们发动闪电般的袭击。
“大家小心了，我们已经深入魔兽山脉几十里，这里的妖兽境界不低，可别出了意外。”
被保护在中间的女子第一次开口，语气温柔，声如天籁。
这可给周围的大汉们打了一针强心剂，都打起了十二分的精神！
谁都不想在这般美丽的女子面前弱了气场，更想好好表现不是。
而跟着女子一同前来的青年更是抓住机会，硬气的拍拍胸脯道：“柔儿姑娘，你放心吧，有我萧战在，一定安全护送你到毒林！”
“什么？你叫萧战？铁血护送队萧铁江的天才儿子？”
不少人听了萧战的自报家门，都露出了惊讶的表情。
而那萧战明显享受众人反应，却故作谦虚道：“呵呵，各位前辈过奖了，在下只是自幼跟随父亲出入魔兽森林，多了些磨炼罢了，算不得什么天才。”
“哎呀，肖少队长太谦虚了，有你在，我们这次入山安全了。”
旁人继续吹捧，萧战谦虚中带着自信的回应，双方一下聊的火热朝天。
江若尘默默听着，从他们的对话中也明白了大概来。
这萧战父亲的护送队在在这一带很有名，也经常跟宝药堂合作，而这萧战从小就跟着护送队经常出入魔兽山脉，耳濡目染下也就经验丰富了，这也就是为什么大家知道是萧战，都觉得安全了的原因。
对此，江若尘倒也没说什么，不用出力就拿报酬自然更好。
只是魔兽森林的凶险，显然不是因为某一个人而能改变的，就在萧战等人聊得正起劲之时，不远处的灌木中猛然冲出一只血毒豹，袭击了队伍的后方。
有两人听得津津有味，放松了警惕，血毒豹速度快若闪电，他们还没反应过来，就被咬断了他们的脖子。
“不好，血毒豹！”

有人惨死，队伍众人这才惊醒，周围的大汉反应过来纷纷拿出武器围攻了上去。
那血毒豹境界不高，很快就被围攻落入了下风。
“让我来结果了这畜生！”
萧战一看功劳要没了，也顾不上待在女子身边了，立马抽刀冲了上去，抢在众人之前一刀了结了那毒血豹。
这家伙下刀干脆利落，实力确实也不俗。
“柔儿姑娘，一头毒豹而已，让你受惊了！
“解决了血毒豹，萧战淡定的回过头。
那叫柔儿的女子对此只是微微点头，显然对萧战没有过多的兴趣，刚想上前查看一下被咬那两人是否还有救时，身旁草丛突然又窜出了两头血毒豹直扑她而去。
“啊！”
柔儿大惊，而此时她身边早就没人保护，人全都去了队伍后方争功去了，眼看血毒豹就要扑到她身上时，一道矫健的少年躯体猛然挡在了她的面前，以迅雷不及掩耳之势向前轰出两拳。
那两头血毒豹都是六重天级别的妖兽，自然是扛不住江若尘的拳头，都是被两拳打飞了出去，其中一只爬起来更是吐血不止，受了非常严重的伤。
content_en:
The trees in the Warcraft Mountains are towering and monsters are everywhere. Even in the fringe areas, there are many monsters living there.
It's just that the realm of the monster beasts on the periphery is relatively low. When they see the huge team of human monks, they stay away from them and don't dare to provoke them easily.
The team's goal was also clear, so they did not waste time on those little monsters. More than twenty people formed a front and rear guard position, protecting the people of the Treasure Medicine Hall, and marched towards the poisonous forest in an orderly manner.
The first section of the journey was uneventful, but as the group went deeper, the surrounding forest began to become more dangerous. They always felt that something in some nearby bushes was observing them, and if they relaxed at all, they would launch a lightning-like attack on them.
"Everyone, be careful. We have penetrated dozens of miles into the Monster Mountain Range. The realm of the monsters here is not low, so don't let anything happen."
The woman who was protected in the middle spoke for the first time, her tone was gentle and her voice was like the sound of nature.
This gave the big men around him a shot in the arm and boosted their spirits!
No one wants to lose their aura in front of such a beautiful woman, and they want to perform well.
The young man who came with the woman seized the opportunity, patted his chest forcefully and said: "Miss Rou'er, don't worry, I, Xiao Zhan, will definitely escort you to the poisonous forest safely!"
"What? Your name is Xiao Zhan? The genius son of Xiao Tiejiang of the Iron-Blooded Escort Team?"
Many people showed surprised expressions after hearing Xiao Zhan's self-report.
Xiao Zhan obviously enjoyed the reaction of the crowd, but he pretended to be humble and said: "Haha, seniors, thank you. I just followed my father in and out of the World of Warcraft Forest since I was a child. It's just a little more training. I can't be considered a genius."
"Oh, Captain Xiao is so humble. With you here, we will be safe in the mountains this time."
Others continued to praise him, Xiao Zhan responded modestly and with confidence, and the two sides chatted in full swing.
Jiang Ruochen listened silently and got a rough idea from their conversation.
The escort team of Xiao Zhan's father is very famous in this area and often cooperates with Baoyaotang. Xiao Zhan has been with the escort team in and out of the Warcraft Mountains since he was a child. He has rich experience under the influence of his ears and eyes. This is why everyone feels safe when they know it is Xiao Zhan.
Jiang Ruochen didn't say anything about this. It would be better to get paid without any effort.
It's just that the danger of the Warcraft Forest obviously cannot be changed by one person. Just when Xiao Zhan and others were chatting enthusiastically, a blood-venomous leopard suddenly rushed out of the bushes not far away and attacked the rear of the team.
Two people listened with great interest and relaxed their vigilance. The blood poisonous leopard was as fast as lightning. Before they could react, their necks were bitten off.
"No, Bloody Leopard!"
Someone died tragically, and everyone in the team woke up. The big men around them reacted and took out their weapons to attack.
The blood poisonous leopard was not at a high level and was quickly besieged and put at a disadvantage.
"Let me kill this beast!"
When Xiao Zhan saw that his credit was gone, he no longer cared about staying by the woman's side. He immediately rushed forward with his sword and killed the poisonous blood leopard with one blow before everyone else.
This guy's swordsmanship is crisp and clean, and his strength is indeed impressive.
"Miss Rou'er, it's just a poisonous leopard, it scared you!
"Having dealt with the Blood Poison Leopard, Xiao Zhan calmly turned around.
The woman named Rou'er just nodded slightly, obviously not too interested in Xiao Zhan. Just when she was about to step forward to see if the two people who were bitten could be saved, two more blood-venomous leopards suddenly emerged from the grass beside her and rushed towards her.
"Ah!"
Rou'er was shocked, but at this time, there was no one protecting her, and everyone went to the back of the team to compete for credit. Just when the blood-venomous leopard was about to pounce on her, a strong young man's body suddenly stood in front of her, and punched forward with two punches at lightning speed.
The two blood-venomed leopards are both sixth-level monsters. Naturally, they cannot hold Jiang Ruochen down.The fists were all knocked out by two punches. One of them got up and vomited blood, suffering very serious injuries.
